3.name: Draconic Resilience
3.notes:
Your draconic gift manifests physically.
- Your Hit Point maximum increases by 3, and increases by 1 each time you gain a Sorcerer level.
- While not wearing armor, your base AC = 10 + Dexterity modifier + Charisma modifier.

3.name: Draconic Spells
3.notes:
You always have the following spells prepared at the listed Sorcerer levels:

3rd: Alter Self, Chromatic Orb, Command, Dragon's Breath
5th: Fear, Fly
7th: Arcane Eye, Charm Monster
9th: Legend Lore, Summon Dragon

6.name: Elemental Affinity
6.notes:
Choose one damage type associated with dragons: Acid, Cold, Fire, Lightning, or Poison.
- You gain Resistance to the chosen damage type.
- When you cast a spell dealing that type, add your Charisma modifier to one damage roll of the spell.

14.name: Dragon Wings
14.notes:
As a Bonus Action, manifest draconic wings that last for 1 hour or until dismissed (no action required). You gain a Fly Speed of 60 ft.

Once used, regain use after a Long Rest, or restore it by spending 3 Sorcery Points.

18.name: Dragon Companion
18.notes:
You can cast Summon Dragon without a Material component.
- You can cast it once without expending a spell slot; regain this use after a Long Rest.
- When you begin casting it, you may choose to remove the Concentration requirement. If so, its duration becomes 1 minute.
